description: Your Downloads folder has 20 recipe text files. Sort them into ~/Documents/Recipes/ with subfolders for Italian, Asian, Mexican, Baking, and Other cuisines — each file goes into exactly one folder based on its name. Rename every file to lowercase with underscores replacing spaces (e.g. 'Pasta Carbonara from Nonna.txt' becomes 'pasta_carbonara_from_nonna.txt'). Apply a Yellow Finder tag to every file. Then create a Smart Folder at ~/Library/Saved Searches/My Recipes.savedSearch that finds all files tagged Yellow inside ~/Documents/Recipes/.
